- Keep the MacBook focused on the canonical SUPRA app.
- When the canonical app is ready/updated, launch it automatically.
- Do not ask Nicolas to copy/paste Terminal commands.

DO NOW:
1) Reconfirm canonical SUPRA PID/path/bundle is alive and healthy before touching any other UI.
2) Gracefully close the SUPRAClean / SUPRA Polaris noncanonical surface. Do NOT delete its files. Prefer application quit; if it refuses, use TERM only, never KILL -9.
3) Inspect visible windows for any separate noncanonical OjoCompanion/ChatGPT/helper window currently overlaying SUPRA. Resolve its owning process first. If it is not required for bridge 18765, OpenCode 4096, updater, or canonical SUPRA, close that WINDOW or quit that helper app gracefully. Do not stop bridge/runtime services.
4) Do not close or terminate canonical SUPRA, bridge 18765, OpenCode 4096, updater LaunchAgent, Finder, or system networking.
5) Activate canonical SUPRA and bring it frontmost. If safe, maximize/zoom its main window without creating a second window.
6) Verify after cleanup:
   - exactly one canonical SUPRA process remains;
   - SUPRAClean count=0;
   - no noncanonical SUPRA Polaris window remains;
   - no OjoCompanion/helper overlay remains if it was safely closable;
   - bridge 18765 healthy;
   - OpenCode 4096 healthy;
   - canonical SUPRA frontmost.
7) Preserve updater behavior: successful future installs must continue to auto-launch canonical SUPRA automatically. Do not create a new updater; use existing one.
8) Emit a non-secret proof receipt and update current local runtime proof if the existing evidence publisher supports it.
